decision.conclusion: M13 DOES NOT BEAT M10 UNDER THE LOCKED ACCEPTANCE GATE
decision.unseen_broadcast_generalization: Partial crop-level improvement on one unseen broadcast game; selected tracklet retrieval and actual reconnect counts do not improve consistently. No broad independent broadcast identity accuracy established.
decision.global_player_split_certification: NOT_VERIFIED: original within-clip GT and metadata guards, not an independent worldwide physical-player registry
decision.reason: Keep frozen M9 serving. Selected model fails combined crop/tracklet gate; fresh TEST is only one game with20 query identities; validation only8 query identities. Better TEST alternative is not substituted post hoc. Shadow/context evidence is qualitative; physical invariants are not identity accuracy.

dataset.quality_audit: Original non-green HSV fraction retained as metadata but excluded as a filter: green uniforms were mistaken for grass. Applied uniformly to all new-source splits before any training or model evaluation; original provisional extraction archived.
dataset.sampling: 0.48s between original SN observations; pHash Hamming>=3 vs previous retained same-track crop; one anchor clip per identity
dataset.limitations: Global physical-player registry absent. Match/annotation-identity/source hashes are checked; club/kit overlap audited conservatively, not proof against unobserved transfers. No broad global identity-disjoint claim.
